question: Which mantras may be recited as part of the expiatory practice?
premises: The Aghora weapon-mantra is an option.
The Śiva weapon-mantra is an option.
The Brahma aṅga mantras are an option.
inference: The practitioner may choose among the Aghora weapon, Śiva weapon, or Brahma aṅga mantras.
plain_english: One may recite the Aghora weapon-mantra, or the Śiva weapon-mantra, or again the Brahma aṅga mantras.
